web_events.answer: In his speech at the Jackson Hole symposium, Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh avoided committing to forward guidance or a reaction function for monetary policy, instead focusing on his approach to governance. He expressed concern about elevated inflation but did not indicate whether he thinks interest rates should be higher or outline the conditions under which he would advocate for a change in policy. web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's National Bureau of Statistics is set to release its official August Purchasing Managers' Indices on Monday at 9:30am Beijing time. The consensus among economists is for the manufacturing PMI to be 49.6, up from July's 49.2 but still below the 50-point line separating expansion from contraction.
